snippet.title: Ascent Release Trailer | Amber Bear
snippet.description:
Ascent is a third-person narrative-driven adventure exploration game inspired by Baltic folklore utilising a dark, handcrafted art style.

Encounter and assist folklore-inspired characters as you climb the hallowed mountain to take the last remaining flame to the summit, all the while becoming immersed in a harsh mythical world conveyed through a fully-illustrated folktale.

COMING SOON

🐻Ascent is created by Amber Bear, a 4-person indie games team.

⛰️Follow us!⛰️
